# Planned new assets (generated by `prod.py assets`; do not edit by hand)

New characters, sets, props, poses and techniques requested by validated creative plans. Planners: reuse a name here when it fits your story (same drawing, different costume/palette/pose) instead of inventing a new one. None of these exist in `Library/` yet unless the guide says so.

## pose (32)

- **person kneel / sit** (9: AN-039, AN-095, KD-009, KD-014, KD-015, KD-017, KD-022, KD-026...): The planned sit 0..1 for the wife on her stool (most of the film) and kneel for the physician at the bedside.
- **person lie / sit up in bed** (5: AN-036, AN-039, KD-010, KD-022, KD-026): The planned lie pose for the Library person, used only for the still body behind the reeds (no blanket, no pillow, eyes not shown).
- **person faceCover** (4: AN-075, AN-087, AN-116, AN-124): Opt-in field faceCover 0..1: a flap of the head cloth or robe (costume colour and dots) is drawn across the face from the far side, hiding eyes and mouth at 1; a puff value makes it bulge 3 px with the breath.
- **person laugh** (4: AN-084, AN-092, AN-103, AN-109): A full laugh for the person figure built from existing fields: mouth 'open', lid 0.8..1, tip negative (lean back), shoulders shaking. No new drawing; a small helper so every film laughs the same way.
- **person youth option** (3: AN-086, AN-103, AN-123): Opt-in youth:true: a teenager between child and adult: no facial hair, head 1.1x, used with s about 0.84.
- **bird carry** (2: AN-042, KD-005): The planned carry option: an object (here the lamb, and the dream sheep) hangs from the talons and swings a beat late.
- **fox rear / carry** (2: AN-038, KD-016): The planned fox rear 0..1 (KD-016) for stretching up to the grapes at 7.36. Carry is not needed here.
- **person carrying a load on the back** (2: AN-132, AN-138): The simpleton (and the cloud man) bent under sacks: tip 0.35, knees bent, packLoad drawn on the back with a strap.
- **person costume 'caliph' crown:false** (2: AN-135, AN-152): Opt-in field that draws the caliph preset with its turban and jewel but without the crown, so a king can travel unrecognised and be revealed by putting the crown on. Default (crown undefined) is unchanged.
- **tortoise acting head, bite and dangle** (2: AN-036, KD-008): The planned optional fields on the Library tortoise (KD-008): neck (extension 0..1), headRot, talk, mouth set (closed, smile, frown, o), brow (negative = worried), front-foot raise. Bite and dangle are not needed here. Defaults must leave the Lion film's tortoise unchanged.
- **bird clipped wings** (1: AN-042): Bird field clipped 0..1: the wing is drawn at 45% length with a rounded end and no primary feathers; flap and sag still work.
- **camel couch / fall / thrash / rider** (1: AN-082): Optional fields on the planned camel (AN-044): couch 0..1 (legs fold, body lowers about 150 units, front knees first going down and rear first getting up), fall 0..1 (rotation onto her side about the feet with the legs stiffening), thrash 0..1 (legs kicking on a seeded 5 Hz cycle and the neck whipping), plus a returned rider anchor (seat point and bob) for one or two riders. If the planned camel already has equivalent fields, use those names.
- **dog headDown / chew / raise / collar / age** (1: AN-104): Extra optional dog fields needed here: headDown 0..1 (muzzle to a dish on the ground, about 95 units ahead of the front feet), chew (jaw cycle), raise 0..1 (near forepaw lifted and extended up to 110 units forward at ground level: the push, the beckon, the paw on a knee; returns the paw point as P.paw), collar: "gold" | "rope" | none (band 14 wide with a ring; P.ring returned for the chain), age 0..1 (grey muzzle and brow, slower tail, belly 0.9).
- **duck dabble (upend)** (1: AN-036): dabble 0..1: the duck tips forward until the tail points straight up, the front half hidden below the water line, feet paddling in the air.
- **elephant crown / talk / wide eyes** (1: KD-012): Optional elephant fields: crown:true (gold three-point crown between the ears, follows hbob), talk 0..1 (small lower-jaw wedge opening under the trunk base), eyes:"wide".
- **fish open (belly flap)** (1: AN-111): Opt-in field open 0..1 on the fish: a curved flap along the lower belly (about 110 long) hinges downward to 70 degrees and shows a dark navy hollow with blue dots, 90 x 44. Nothing anatomical is drawn. The hollow is the stage for the glow and the pearl.
- **monkey rot (flip, handstand) and fez** (1: AN-045): An optional rot field (radians about the body centre, about 90 units above the feet) for back flips, cartwheels and handstands, and an optional hat:"fez" drawn on the head. Off by default so the regression test stays identical.
- **monkey tailPath / pinch / armLen** (1: KD-009): Optional monkey fields: tailPath (array of points or a function giving the tail centre line, so the tail can hang down the side of the log, lie in the gap, go taut, trail limp, be lifted by a hand), tailClip (a seam line below which the tail is hidden), tailKink (0..1 zigzag and flattening near a given point) and armLen (arm length multiplier up to 1.5 for the long reach to the wedge). Defaults keep the current look.
- **mountedRider** (1: AN-085): A person seated on a mount (horse, planned camel, later donkey): rideOn(mountFn, mountP, personP, {weapon}). The rider is drawn from the hips up (front-facing torso and head as the Library person, clipped at the saddle line), one flat leg shape hanging on the near side with a stirrup, hips at the mount saddlePoint, following its bob with a 2-frame lag and lurching on a stop. weapon: sword or spear in the raised hand via aR angles.
- **mourning palette** (1: AN-149): Costume palette override for grief: any preset in near-black with grey dots and no jewel (values in cast.teacher.look), plus crooked headwear (rotate the head group 0.08 rad if the figure allows, otherwise shift the turban 4 units).
- **person bigFeet** (1: AN-127): Opt-in foot scale (default 1) so shoes draw 1.5x long and peek from under a long robe; Ayishah running callback.
- **person blindfold** (1: AN-116): Cloth band over both eyes with a knot and two tails at the side of the head; blindfold: true, or 0.5 = pushed up on the forehead; colour pal.blind (default blue).
- **person hairVeil** (1: AN-103): Opt-in long loose hair on the maiden/lady presets: hair 0..1 drawn down past the shoulders, and hairVeil 0..1 sweeping it across the face (for sleeping or grieving figures).
- **person headwear offset (crooked turban, turban hop)** (1: AN-112): A small headwear offset and tilt so Abu's turban can sit crooked, jump off in shock (60.84) and land again.
- **person hold:'oud' (playOud)** (1: AN-109): Playing pose for any person, standing or seated: the oud lies diagonally across the torso (neck up toward the figure's left), the right hand strums over the sound hole, the left hand moves along the neck.
- **person mouthItem** (1: AN-086): Opt-in field mouthItem: draws a small callback (here a gem) held between the teeth of an open grin, with cheeks 0..1 puff.
- **person pant** (1: AN-144): Exhausted stance for any runner: body tipped 0.14, mouth open pulsing at 3 Hz, lid 0.5, chest sq 1 +/- 0.02, optional hands on knees, 3 sweat drops.
- **person plainShirt look** (1: AN-119): A costume variant for the 'shamed' poet: ankle-length plain white long-sleeved shirt, no headwear, short hair, bare feet. Fully covered; reusable for prisoners, penitents, sleepers.
- **person shawl (shoulder slip)** (1: AN-126): Opt-in field shawl 0..1 on the lady / maiden / villageWoman presets: a short shoulder shawl over the robe (yellow with red dots). 0 = sits evenly on both shoulders; 1 = slid off the near shoulder and hanging at the elbow, showing only the sleeve of the robe underneath. The discreet stand-in for the script's displaced garment; the robe itself never changes.
- **reclineOnMount** (1: AN-143): A person lying along the back of a donkey (head toward the rump, feet toward the head), then sitting up into the normal rideOn seat. No new drawing: the Library lie pose placed at mountSeat.
- **templeTap** (1: AN-099): Person hand to the temple with a single tap (mind, thinking, clever). Used by the caliph in S6 and the stranger in S13 and S16. Candidate entry PERSON_HANDS.temple.
- **thief disguise turban** (1: AN-107): The planned thief disguise overlay (KD-013), turban item only: a small white turban drawn over the cap of the thief kind, following head moves; also drawable as a loose prop.

## motion (22)

- **sneak** (12: AN-045, AN-075, AN-089, AN-103, AN-104, AN-107, AN-116, AN-123...): The planned tiptoe option for walk(): high knees, a short hold on each toe. Used 60.5 to 61.5 for four steps.
- **handOver** (6: AN-113, AN-126, AN-135, AN-138, AN-140, AN-151): A small object passes from one person's hand to another's (purse S3 and S13, note S13, purses S10): the object follows hand A, then eases to hand B over 0.25 s with a weight dip on arrival; both gazes follow it.
- **runInPlace** (4: AN-040, AN-107, KD-017, KD-026): The planned comic wind up: legs cycle at full run amplitude with no travel for about 0.35 s, dust building behind, then release. Used for the leopard at 140.0.
- **costume change behind a foreground wipe** (3: AN-044, AN-087, AN-095): Planned in AN-095: a walker passes behind a foreground palm trunk and comes out in the next costume.
- **carryRig** (2: KD-008, KD-019): Two carriers hold a bar and a rider hangs from its middle: bar ends follow the carriers, the bar bends with the load, the rider swings from the midpoint and can let go.
- **rideOn** (2: AN-084, AN-098): A front-facing person riding a side-view quadruped (horse, donkey, later camel). The rider's hips sit on the mount's P.back point, inherit its bob and rear angle, and lurch on stops.
- **swimPath** (2: KD-007, KD-019): Fish motion from a keyed 2D path: returns x, y, dir, rot, ph, amp, bend for any time.
- **weakFlight** (2: AN-036, KD-031): The planned tired flight in sagging arcs for the arrival at 36.9-38.5.
- **bumpChain** (1: KD-012): A line of walkers concertinas when the leader stops: each follower closes up, bumps, lurches forward and settles back (named in the Capabilities Guide wish list).
- **digCycle** (1: AN-131): Person digging with the shovel: push down (0.2 s), lever, throw over the shoulder side (0.25 s), return; one cycle about 0.6 s, with a dirt burst at the throw.
- **generations** (1: AN-088): Time passing shown on a worker: age 0 to 1, tool handed to a child, the child scales up to an adult and continues; repeat. Reusable for any "years passed" beat with people.
- **handOver, person laugh, headwear offset** (1: AN-133): Planned helpers: pass an object between hands with a weight dip; the shared full laugh; a headwear offset and tilt for the crown hop.
- **handOver, templeTap** (1: AN-152): Planned helpers: an object passes from one hand to another with a weight dip (bowl at 14.98 and 23.06); a finger tapped on the temple (the father at 95.44).
- **person laugh / templeTap / handOver** (1: AN-141): Planned shared helpers: the full laugh (mouth open, lid 0.9, lean back, shoulder shake) for the three neighbours at 137.46, the finger at the temple for the bean seller at 134.40, and passing the fish between two hands at 5.94.
- **person laugh / templeTap / handOver / carry load** (1: AN-137): Planned shared helpers reused under their planned names: the full laugh (mouth open, lid 0.9, tip back, shoulder shake), the temple tap, passing a small object between two hands, and the bent carry pose with a sack on the back.
- **person laugh, flush, templeTap (planned helpers)** (1: AN-143): Shared planned helpers reused under their names: the full laugh (mouth open, lid 0.9, tip back, shoulder shake), the anger flush with steam puffs (and soft option), a finger tapped on the temple.
- **person laugh, handOver** (1: AN-123): Planned helpers: the shared full laugh (125.5) and passing a small object between two hands (pen at 108.95, gifts at 145.1).
- **sneak / tiptoe gait** (1: AN-132): High knee tiptoe for the approach (22.5-25.6).
- **sneak, runInPlace, bumpChain** (1: AN-105): Planned motions: tiptoe gait for walk() (S10, S11, S13, S20), the comic wind up before a dash (S2, S16), and the concertina of a stopped line (S4) reused for the ring of leaners collapsing (S16).
- **streetCrowd** (1: AN-142): Planned helper (AN-107) for a small crowd of person presets in two depth rows; here five fixed members with staggered entries, accordion stop, ripple reactions (gasp, nod, step back).
- **strikeCycle** (1: AN-145): The guide's strike cycle (Fox branch) applied to a person with a pickaxe: lift 0.3 s, whip down, contact on the cue, damped rebound; a slow variant with doubled period for fatigue.
- **tiptoe** (1: AN-125): Sneaking gait for the person figure: short stride, high knee, rise on each step.

## effect (64)

- **iconBalloon** (30: AN-014, AN-036, AN-038, AN-039, AN-045, AN-046, AN-087, AN-089...): Planned wordless picture balloon in strip mode for the jinn gossip (three frames) and single mode for the news in S7.
- **thoughtCloud** (19: AN-001, AN-036, AN-038, AN-039, KD-005, KD-007, KD-008, KD-009...): The planned generic thought cloud (already requested by many stories): here a 380 x 240 plan board at (500, 420) in which small versions of the bull, plough, trough and worker act out each step, plus two small uses (S16, S19).
- **goldGlow** (14: AN-083, AN-097, AN-103, AN-104, AN-108, AN-111, AN-113, AN-114...): The planned treasure light (KD-031): tapering yellow rays with a halftone disc and staggered star glints, strength 0..1; used on the arrowheads.
- **dayCycle** (11: AN-001, AN-036, KD-005, KD-007, KD-010, KD-011, KD-015, KD-016...): The planned sky that runs day, dusk, night, dawn with the sun and moon on arcs; used for the field time-lapse (102.3-104.8), the two evenings and the two mornings, and seen through the stable window and door.
- **musicNotes** (8: AN-089, AN-097, AN-103, AN-109, AN-124, AN-127, AN-141, AN-149): n quaver glyphs released from a point that rise on seeded S-paths, rock and fade; colour black with a yellow or red head.
- **dream wash** (7: AN-046, AN-095, AN-105, AN-144, AN-149, KD-013, KD-022): The planned blue halftone overlay and dotted vignette, used to mark the told flashback (S6).
- **featherFall** (6: AN-036, AN-038, AN-041, AN-042, AN-046, AN-075): n feathers released at a point at time t0 that rock down on seeded sway paths and come to rest on the ground; also the single still feather prop (white or dark).
- **splash** (6: AN-036, AN-087, AN-105, AN-153, KD-007, KD-019): The planned crown of drops with rings for the landing at 38.9 and the dabbling.
- **verseRibbon** (6: AN-103, AN-124, AN-125, AN-126, AN-154, AN-155): Poetry made visible: a paper band with squiggle lines of writing that unrolls from the poet along a curve, can carry small icons, curl round an object and roll up again. The visual counterpart of musicNotes.
- **groundShadow** (5: AN-036, AN-038, AN-046, AN-153, KD-008): The planned moving shadow of a flying bird on the sand (23.9, 147.8, 152.6-157).
- **inset circle** (5: AN-097, AN-103, AN-109, AN-113, AN-145): Planned round picture-in-picture with an iris: the two sons (57.3, 58.22), the jewel memory (76.04, 136.32) and Yahya's gift replayed (123.74).
- **fightCloud** (4: AN-046, AN-114, KD-005, KD-016): The planned comic scuffle cloud (KD-005, KD-016): churning dust puffs with stars, wings and feet poking out, hiding the fight.
- **painPulse** (4: AN-001, AN-039, KD-009, KD-022): The planned red throb at a point (rings plus three small stars) for the bull's aches (36.0) and the donkey's (107.5, 111.8, 168.6).
- **worryScribble** (4: AN-092, AN-133, AN-151, AN-152): A small black scribble cloud over a worried head that can pulse, shrink and burst.
- **ghostForm** (3: AN-082, AN-114, AN-145): Draws any Library character as a vision: pale blue tint, alpha, a wavy hem instead of legs and feet, a soft halftone halo, and an earlier mist stage (two tapering bands on a bezier that gather into a column). Used for Hatim in the dream (S11), in the thought cloud (S17) and at the end (S18), and for the mist in S7.
- **hunterShadow** (3: AN-041, AN-116, AN-131): A character's cast shadow on a wall that shows a different pose from the character (his true nature): flat black silhouette, scaled, 2 frames late.
- **skyLight** (3: AN-075, AN-142, KD-014): The planned soft cone of yellow halftone light from the top of the frame (or through the cave mouth), strength 0..1, used for the prayers.
- **weekDots** (3: AN-099, AN-141, AN-144): Seven small discs in a row, n of them lit with a star, for once or twice a week, days passing, or a count of meetings.
- **aerialStrip** (2: KD-008, KD-019): Scrolling ground seen from the air in three parallax layers (crowns, roofs, far patchwork).
- **angelLight** (2: AN-075, AN-111): A figure turns into a tall faceless shape of light and rises: p 0..0.4 bleaches the person from the feet up to white and yellow; p 0.4..1 replaces it with a tapering light column 90 wide x 300 tall with a round glow at head height, two wings (span 320, 6 lobes) that beat once, yellow halftone rays and star glints; then it shrinks to a star.
- **goldGlow, inset circle** (2: AN-098, AN-134): Planned treasure light (rays and star glints, strength 0..1) and the planned round picture-in-picture with an iris, used once for the confession replay.
- **groundWindow** (2: AN-039, KD-031): The planned round window into the earth, used once (157.06 to 160.2) to show the hoard under the burrow.
- **heatShimmer** (2: AN-083, AN-144): Hot-day cue: 3 to 5 thin wavy horizontal strokes rising slowly above the ground line plus a pulsing ring round the sun.
- **lampLight** (2: KD-010, KD-026): A carried lamp lights a disc of the dark room: yellow halftone disc r 150 that follows the lamp; in macro, a disc sliding over the bedding.
- **poofTransform** (2: AN-132, KD-014): Planned transformation burst (KD-014): stars spiral in, star burst and puff ring with a 2 frame flash, two black silhouettes cross scaled inside (from, to), puff clears. Used inside the tale cloud forward (man to donkey, 81.78) and reversed (donkey to man, 95.94).
- **priceTags** (2: AN-084, AN-145): The price ladder: an ordered list of amount tags with states (hidden, pop, live, struck, locked, unstruck, dropping) driven by a keyed state table, layouts 'column' (right or left aligned staircase) and 'row'; plus the running-total counter. Reusable for any bargaining or counting story.
- **sandBlow** (2: AN-088, AN-145): Turns any drawn character into sand that blows away, with no body left: p 0..0.3 the figure is redrawn in one sand tone with dot shading (same idea as the planned statueTint), p 0.3..1 a wipe line travels from head to feet, the part above it replaced by seeded dust dots streaming sideways and fading. Reusable for vanishing, curses, time passing over ruins.
- **sleepMeter** (2: KD-010, KD-026): Ten-segment SLEEP bar with a DEEP mark; value keyed over time: 3 (55.8), preview fill (57.06), 4 to 5 (68..71), 3 (75.5), 5 (83.4), 7 (85.4), 0 red AWAKE (95.8), fills to 10 (145.3..146.5).
- **stinkLines** (2: AN-090, AN-111): Smell lines with flies, with a rose option (see props). Running gag of the film; reusable for rubbish, old fish, perfume (rose mode).
- **answerBalloon** (1: AN-099): Speech balloon with icon content and a badge. answerBalloon(ctx, x, y, w, h, t, {p (pop 0..1), tail:[x, y], icon:'knot'|'wedge'|'pieces'|'whole'|'wide'|'lamp'|'dots', tangle (1..2 extra loops), untie 0..1 (knot to straight line), col, grow 0..1 (wide: 220x160 to 820x330, icons book, star, crescent, compass pop at grow 0.2, 0.45, 0.7, 0.9), mark:'?'|'tick'|null}). Default size 380 x 240; small 150 x 110.
- **blurVision** (1: KD-022): Weak-sight point of view: whatever is drawn inside is shown doubled and drifting with a pale halftone veil, strength 0..1. Used three times (stall shelf, tray, bowl) so the audience learns it once and recognises it later.
- **claimPile** (1: AN-092): A wobbling stack of tiles tied to the bag by a three-bubble trail: add tiles on cue times, sway, droop, collapse.
- **crowdDots** (1: AN-092): Dozens of tiny heads (dot with two eye dots, optional raised hand) for thousands of witnesses and the queue in the judge's balloon.
- **dream frame (full-panel thoughtCloud)** (1: AN-112): A thought cloud that grows from a character until its edge becomes the panel frame, for a narrated dream or flashback, then shrinks back.
- **elementFace** (1: KD-014): One face rig for things that are not animals: two eyes (with per-eye lids lidL/lidR, gaze, brow), a mouth (closed, smile, frown, o, talk) and a width parameter. Used on the sun (150 wide), cloud (130), wind curl (70) and mountain (ledges as lids, crack as mouth).
- **gasPuff (with planned stinkLines)** (1: AN-143): Comic fart puff: burst, drift, three wavy smell lines; reusable for smoke puffs and bad smells.

- **hundredWindows** (1: AN-134): Diagram of a great house: facade 700 x 630 with crenellations and a door, a ten by ten grid of windows (46 x 40, pitch 64 x 58). - **skyCry** (1: AN-088): A blast from the sky: five concentric white ring strokes (black outlined) expanding from a point at the top of the frame over 0.9 s, a 2-frame white flash at the peak, panel-only shake. Reusable for thunder, a divine voice, an explosion or a giant roar.
- **skyFire** (1: AN-142): A bolt of flame from the sky: zigzag path 70 wide of red with a yellow core and black brush outline drawing downward in 5 frames, then a 2-frame white flash of the whole panel, then a scorch disc (ellipse 220 x 40, black dots) and three grey smoke puffs.
